ActiveSession.description: One live session row, as the account page lists it.

ApiErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every API failure: `code`, a human message, optional data.

additionalProperties.description: One setting value: the catalog defines text and switch settings only.

BulkUpdateProductsInput.description: One round trip for the table's bulk bar. Tags are added, never replaced.

CategoryInput.description:
`{ name, sortOrder, active, departmentIds }`, for create and update alike:
the update replaces every field.

ChangePasswordOutput.description: `{ changed }`; false when the submitted password was the current one.

CouponInput.description: The body of both create and update: the update replaces every field.

kitIds.description: Kits the scope covers, same `include`/`exclude` reading as products.

CouponProductScopeMode.description: `include` applies only to the listed products, `exclude` to the rest.

CouponStatus.description:
`active`, `expired` or `disabled`; `expired` is derived, never written by
the panel.

CouponWriteStatus.description: The two states the write path accepts.

CreateBadgeInput.description:
`{ name, imageUrl, sortOrder?, isActive? }`. Order and visibility default to
`0` and `true` when omitted.

CreateKitInput.description:
A whole kit. Groups, dishes and bands travel with it: the write replaces
the full set.

CreateProductInput.description:
`{ name, description, subcategoryId, tagIds, badgeIds, available, archived,
hidden, private, sortOrder, variations }`.

EntitySeoOutput.description: `{ saved, resolved }` after a read, write or revert.

ErrorCode.description:
The eight error codes the TypeScript backend exposed. The wire strings and
their PT-BR messages are verbatim, and are not ours to improve: a client
already switches on them.

Health.description:
`{"status":"ok","service":"tenant","timestamp":"<ISO-8601 ms Z>"}`, exactly
the shape the retired endpoint returned.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with milliseconds and a trailing Z.

IntegrationConfigValue.description: One setting value: the catalog defines text and switch settings only.

KitBandInput.description: One progressive band in a create or update payload.

KitGroupInput.description: One group in a create or update payload.

id.description:
Client-assigned id, stable across a reorder. The editor mints one for a
new group so a dish can name it in the same payload.

KitItemInput.description: One dish in a create or update payload.

KitKind.description: How the dish quantities are locked.

KitPricingMode.description: How the kit price is computed before the percentage and the bands.

KitUnavailableBehavior.description: What the storefront does once the minimums can no longer be composed.

ListSeoEntitiesInput.description:
`?entityType=` filters the list; omitted means every type.

The slug stays a string here so the handler can answer an unknown one with
the catalog's `VALIDATION_FAILED` envelope instead of the extractor's.

LoginInput.description: `v.strictObject({ email, password })`, with its own gates.

LoginOutput.description: `{ member, memberships }` — the login and registration answer.

Onboarding.description: The member's onboarding answers, or `null` when unanswered.

OnboardingReferral.description: The optional "how did you hear about us" answer.

OrderAxis.description: Which axis of an order a transition moves.

PanelAuditLog.description: One line of the store's audit trail.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 with milliseconds and a trailing `Z`.

PanelBadge.description: `{ id, name, imageUrl, sortOrder, isActive, itemsCount }`.

PanelBulkDeleteOutput.description: `{ deleted, skipped }`: protected products are skipped, not fatal.

PanelBulkSkipped.description: One product the bulk delete left alone.

PanelCategory.description:
`{ id, name, active, sortOrder, itemsCount, updatedAt, departmentIds,
departmentNames }`.

PanelCoupon.description: `{ id, code, description, discountType, valueCents, valuePercent, … }`.

PanelCouponCustomer.description: The customer an order's redemption belongs to.

PanelCouponDeleteOutput.description:
`{ success, archived }`: the dialog tells the member which of the two
happened.

PanelCouponDetailOutput.description:
`{ coupon, products, redemptions, redemptionsTotal, usage,
ordersWithCouponCents }`.

ordersWithCouponCents.description:
Sum of the orders that used this coupon, so the ticket average needs no
second read.

redemptionsTotal.description: Rows the search matches, so the client knows how many pages exist.

PanelCouponOrder.description: The order a redemption was written for.

PanelCouponOutput.description: `{ coupon }`, returned by create and update alike.

PanelCouponProduct.description: A product named by the coupon's scope, for the detail chips.

PanelCouponRedemption.description: One row of the coupon detail's redemption history.

PanelCouponStatusInput.description: `{ status }`; the switch writes only `active` or `disabled`.

PanelCouponSummary.description: One coupon row plus what the list needs, so the table never counts per row.

effectiveStatus.description: Derived from `endsAt`: a coupon past its window reads as expired.

PanelCouponUsagePoint.description: One bucket of the usage series, keyed by the redemption day (UTC).

PanelCustomer.description: A customer plus the totals derived from their orders in this store.

PanelCustomerOutput.description:
`{ customer, orders }`: the same row the list carries, plus their orders
newest first.

PanelIntegration.description: One catalog integration's state for a store, with defaults filled in.

PanelKitBand.description: One progressive band: from `min_quantity` kits up, take `percent` off.

PanelKitDetail.description: The editor's read: the row plus groups, dishes and bands.

PanelKitGroup.description: A group of dishes, with optional bounds on the units it accepts.

PanelKitItem.description: One dish in the kit, bound to the variation the manager chose.

allowSwap.description: When true the buyer may pick another variation from `swapVariationIds`.

quantity.description: Locked quantity; only the `fixed` kind carries it.

PanelKitOptionProduct.description: One product the kit editor can add as a dish.

PanelKitOptionVariation.description: One variation a dish can point at.

PanelKitOptionsOutput.description: `{ products }`: the catalog the kit editor picks dishes from.

PanelMcpSession.description: One connected MCP client. Never carries the token, only its identification.

PanelOrder.description:
One order row as the panel's tables render it. Money is Int cents and the
two status axes are independent; `paidAt`/`expiresAt` cross as null rather
than being omitted.

paidAt.description: RFC 3339 with milliseconds and a trailing `Z`.

PanelOrderDetail.description: One order plus its lines and event trail.

PanelOrderEvent.description:
One row of the append-only order trail. `type` stays free text so a new
event does not break an older panel; `actorName` is null for a machine
action or a member that is gone.

PanelOrderItem.description: One line of an order, with the name and price copied at checkout time.

PanelOrderStateOutput.description: What a mutation returns: both axes plus the moves that are still legal.

PanelOrderTransition.description:
One legal move out of the order's current state, already filtered by the
caller's capabilities.

PanelOrderTransitionInput.description:
`POST …/orders/{orderCode}/transition` body. The path addresses the order,
so the body only names the axis, the target and the optional reason.

PanelPaymentAssignment.description: Which integration answers one payment method for the store.

PanelPaymentAssignmentsOutput.description: `{ assignments }`, the whole routing table after the write.

PanelPaymentIntegration.description: One gateway connection as the panel lists it.

hasCredentials.description: Whether a credential is stored. The secret itself never leaves the API.

PanelPaymentIntegrationOutput.description: `{ integration }`, returned by create and update alike.

PanelProduct.description: The fields every product response carries.

PanelProductDetail.description:
The editor's read: the base fields, the description, every variation and
the optional label.

PanelProductList.description: A list row: the base product plus the price window and the stock summary.

PanelProductNutrition.description:
The nutrition label. Nutrients are per 100 g/mL: kcal for energy, mg for
the rest; the portion is thousandths of a gram or millilitre.

PanelProductTag.description: A tag as the panel and the storefront both render it.

PanelProductVariation.description: One variation with its price and stock.

PanelResolvedSeo.description:
The values a page renders, resolved entity → store row → settings template
→ static fallback.

PanelSearchGroup.description: The rows of one kind, already ranked and capped.

PanelSearchItem.description:
One palette row. `status` stays free text (`active`, `disabled`, `expired`,
`available`, `unavailable`); the labels stay in the UI.

href.description: App-relative, resolved per kind from the store's slug.

sublabel.description: A coupon's description, a customer's e-mail, …

PanelSearchKind.description: Entities the palette searches. There is no page kind on purpose.

PanelSearchOutput.description:
`{ canWrite, groups }`. `canWrite` only enables the palette's quick
actions; the write routes re-check the capability.

PanelSeoSource.description: The winning level per inheritable field.

PanelStore.description:
The store plus the caller's membership on it, as the picker and the
dashboard header read them.

PanelSubcategory.description:
`{ id, name, categoryId, categoryName, active, sortOrder, itemsCount,
updatedAt }`.

PanelTeamMember.description: One member of the store, with the role the capability map reads.

joinedAt.description: RFC 3339 with milliseconds and a trailing `Z`.

PaymentIntegrationStatus.description: `active` or `disabled`, the two states the column accepts.

ProductBadgeRef.description: A badge reference: the image is the whole point.

ProductVariationInput.description:
One variation in a create or update payload. An `id` present updates the
row; an omitted one inserts a new variation.

PushPreferencesInput.description: `v.strictObject({ events })`, at most one row per event and no duplicates.

ResolveHostOutput.description: The tenant the host names, or `null` when no `Domain` row has it.

tenantId.description: Always present: an unknown host answers `null`, never a missing key.

RevokeSessionOutput.description: `{ revoked }`, the number of rows the statement actually changed.

SaveIntegrationInput.description: The body of the switch and the config save.

SaveOnboardingInput.description:
`v.strictObject({ persona, segment?, referral? })`.

The picklists are enforced by the enums: an unknown persona, segment or
referral fails deserialization before the handler runs.

SavePaymentIntegrationInput.description: The body of create and update: absent `integrationId` creates.

secretKey.description:
Required to create an online integration; absent on update keeps the
stored credential.

SavePaymentMethodAssignmentInput.description: The method arrives in the path; `null` clears the assignment.

SaveProductNutritionInput.description: A partial label save, merged onto the stored row before validation.

SaveSeoInput.description: Partial write of one entity's override.

SaveStoreSeoInput.description: `{ settings }` write payload; every field is sent, `null` clears it.

SeoEntityItem.description: One row the SEO list screen shows.

SeoEntityType.description: One kind of page an override can describe.

SeoFields.description: The five editable columns of one override row.

SeoSourceLevel.description:
Which inheritance level won a field. `Store` covers the settings template
too: it is store-level configuration.

SessionMember.description: The authenticated member, as the session payload carries it.

SessionMembership.description: One store the member may open in the dashboard.

StoreSeoOutput.description: `{ settings, resolved }` for the store-level screen.

StoreSeoSettings.description: The store's own defaults: the two templates plus the store-level image.

SubcategoryInput.description: `{ name, categoryId, sortOrder, active }`, for create and update alike.

TenantRole.description: A `TenantMembership.role` narrowed to the closed set.

UpdateBadgeInput.description:
`{ name?, imageUrl?, sortOrder?, isActive? }`. A partial save: an omitted
field keeps the stored value.

UpdateDepartmentInput.description:
`{ name, active, moveProductsToCategoryId }`. The target moves the
department's products into that category's `Geral` subcategory when the
department is deactivated.

UpdateKitInput.description:
A partial update: an omitted field keeps the stored value, `null` clears
the nullable ones. Groups, dishes and bands are replaced as a set when
present, so the handler validates them against the merged kit.

UpdateProductInput.description:
A partial update: an omitted field keeps the stored value, `null` clears
the nullable ones. Variations are replaced as a set when present.

parameters.description: SHA-256 digest of the session token.
parameters.name: sessionId

get.summary: The shape the retired endpoint returned, unchanged.

post.summary: Creates a store and makes the authenticated caller its `owner`.

get.summary:
Resolves the dashboard URL's `storeSlug` to the tenant and the caller's
membership. A non-member and an unknown store both answer `NOT_FOUND`.
The store's audit trail, newest first.
Badges with their product counts, by display order then name.

post.summary: Creates a badge; order and visibility default to `0` and `true`.

delete.summary: Deletes a badge; its product links cascade with it.

put.summary: Updates a badge partially: an omitted field keeps the stored value.

parameters.description: Name fragment; empty lists every category.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Only categories linked to this department.
parameters.name: departmentId

get.summary: Categories with their item counts and department links.

post.summary: Creates a category, its department links and its `Geral` subcategory.

delete.summary: Deletes a category without products; its subcategories cascade with it.

put.summary: Replaces every field of the category and its whole department set.

get.summary: The store's coupons, before the usage aggregates.

post.summary: Creates a coupon and its product scope.
Deletes or archives the whole selection in one transaction.

get.summary: The store's coupons with their redemption totals.

delete.summary: Deletes a coupon, or archives it when the ledger still names it.

parameters.description: Customer name/e-mail or order code, matched in SQL.
parameters.name: search

get.summary: One coupon with a page of its redemption history and its usage series.

put.summary: Replaces every field of the coupon and its whole product scope.

post.summary: The switch writes the stored status; a coupon past its window is refused.

get.summary: Every customer of the store, with order count and total spent in cents.
One customer and their orders, newest first.

parameters.description: Name fragment; empty lists every department.
parameters.name: q

get.summary: Departments with their item counts.

post.summary: Creates a department of the store.

delete.summary: Deletes a department no category is linked to.

put.summary:
Renames a department and flips its active flag, moving its products when it
is deactivated with stock inside.

get.summary: Every catalog integration with this store's state.
Who is connected to this store's dashboard MCP right now.

post.summary: Revokes one connected MCP session and the token it uses.
Turns an integration on or off, or writes its config.

get.summary:
The catalog the editor picks dishes from: every product with its
variations, grouped here so the client does one request.
Kits with their dish counts, ordered by `sortOrder` then name.

post.summary: Creates a kit with its whole composition.

delete.summary: Archives a kit. Dishes, groups and bands stay: an archived kit is history.

get.summary: One kit with its groups, dishes and bands.

put.summary:
Replaces a kit with its whole composition. An omitted field keeps the stored
value; `null` clears a nullable one.

get.summary: The store's orders, newest first, narrowed by the optional closed filters.

One order, addressed by the code the dashboard URL carries, with its lines
and its append-only trail.

post.summary: Records the money landing and credits the cashback exactly once.
Moves one axis of the order, appending the trail entry.

get.summary: What the caller may do next on both axes.
The store's gateway connections and the provider of each method.

post.summary: Creates or updates one gateway connection.

delete.summary: Deletes a connection no payment method points at.

put.summary: Points one payment method at one integration, or clears it with `null`.

parameters.description: `asc` or `desc`; nulls sort last either way.
parameters.name: order

get.summary: The store's catalog, sorted the way the table asked.

post.summary:
Creates the product, its variations and its tag and badge links in one
transaction.
Applies one patch to the selection, all-or-nothing on ownership.
Deletes the deletable part of the selection and reports the rest.

delete.summary: Deletes a product no order or kit points at.

get.summary: The editor's read: the product, its variations and its tags.

put.summary:
A partial update: only the fields present are written, variations are
matched by id, and tags and badges are replaced only when sent.

parameters.description: The product whose label is saved.
parameters.name: productId

put.summary:
Merges a partial label onto the stored row, validates the result and
returns the detail the editor re-renders.

get.summary: Every kind the palette searches, each group already ranked and capped.
The store's templates plus the values a page inherits from them.

put.summary:
Writes the store-level templates. One row per tenant, so the write is an
upsert and two admin tabs cannot lose each other's save.

parameters.description: One type, or every type when omitted.
parameters.name: entityType

get.summary: Every entity of the requested type with its override flag.

parameters.description: The kind of page the override describes.
parameters.name: entityType

parameters.description: The entity's id inside the store.
parameters.name: entityId

delete.summary:
Drops the whole override row, which is what "Reverter tudo" asks for. An
entity that was never saved is a no-op, not a `NOT_FOUND`.

parameters.description: The kind of page the override describes.
parameters.name: entityType

parameters.description: The entity's id inside the store.
parameters.name: entityId

get.summary: One entity's saved override plus the values a page would render.

parameters.description: The kind of page the override describes.
parameters.name: entityType

parameters.description: The entity's id inside the store.
parameters.name: entityId

put.summary:
Saves one entity's override, partially: an omitted field keeps the stored
value and `null` reverts that field. A row left with no field is deleted.

parameters.description: Name fragment; empty lists every subcategory.
parameters.name: q

get.summary: Subcategories with their category name and item counts.

post.summary: Creates a subcategory inside a category of the store.

put.summary: Replaces every field of the subcategory, including its category.

get.summary: Tags with their product counts.

post.summary: Creates a tag of the store.

delete.summary: Deletes a tag no product carries.

put.summary: Replaces the tag's name and visibility.

get.summary: The store's team, oldest membership first.
